symptom: With an organization requirements.toml that allows only on-request approval, every Zeros Codex turn failed with 'invalid thread settings override … not in the allowed set' because Zeros sent fixed approval/sandbox values and never read configRequirements/read.
rule: Read Codex managed requirements before thread/start; offer only allowed modes; fall back only to a stricter allowed mode (never silently drop the sandbox or approval prompt); refuse blocked explicit switches with the policy message, Local and cloud alike. See playbooks/bug-fix.md.
